name: Artificial Analysis
description: A starting point for comparing model capabilities, measured endpoint performance and pricing, with image/video comparisons as well.
check: Choose the task and modality first. Read the index methodology, model version, evaluation date and inference settings. API price/performance is not the same as a consumer chat subscription or your laptop’s performance.
caution: Composite scores hide trade-offs. A preference-based media score does not establish factual accuracy, rights clearance or suitability for government use.

name: Arena
description: Explore task-specific leaderboards, including text, images and video. Preference comparisons are one useful signal about how people judge outputs.
check: Read the selected board’s method: do not assume every score uses the same evaluation. For preference rankings, inspect the confidence interval and rank spread as well as the displayed rank.
caution: A popular or persuasive answer can still be wrong. Small rank differences with overlapping uncertainty do not establish a clear winner; check task coverage and evaluation conditions.

name: Stanford HELM
description: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models encourages comparison across scenarios and multiple metrics, rather than one overall number.
check: Select a suite and inspect its release date, included models, scenarios and measures. The linked foundational explanation is from 2022: it explains the approach, not today’s best models.
caution: Coverage is deliberately incomplete. Do not treat an unlisted model as worse or transfer a result to a different task. The live JavaScript results were not independently verified in this content review.

name: SWE-bench
description: Explore evaluations of systems resolving software-repository issues. Useful when learning about coding agents and their surrounding harnesses.
check: Compare like-for-like suites and settings. Record the model, agent/harness, tools, attempt budget and result verification. Read which subset or variant the score refers to.
caution: A resolved-issue score measures that evaluation setup, not all programming ability, deployment security or general AI quality. A model and an agent system are not interchangeable leaderboard entries.

name: Hugging Face Papers
description: A community research feed for discovering papers and following links to the original work. A complement to leaderboards, not another quality ranking.
check: Read the original paper’s date, methods, limitations and publication status. Look for reproducible evidence and later corrections; use the linked publisher model card and release notes for availability claims.
caution: Trending is not peer review or safety approval. Linked code, datasets, models and Spaces require separate review. Reading a paper does not require downloading a model or running its repository.
